00059 BufferChannelInternal::BufferChannelInternal(const unsigned int size, bool zeroData) throw()
00060 : size_(size),
00061  allocatedSize(size)
00062 {
00063  ugen_assert(size > 0);
00064  
00065  data = new float[size_];
00066  
00067  if(zeroData)
00068  { 
00069   memset(data, 0, size_ * sizeof(float));
00070  }
00071  
00072 #ifdef BUFFERTESTMEMORY
00073  reportDataPtr(data, size_);
00074 #endif
00075 }

00077 BufferChannelInternal::BufferChannelInternal(const unsigned int size, const unsigned int sourceDataSize, const float* sourceData) throw()
00078 : size_(size),
00079  allocatedSize(size)
00080 {
00081  ugen_assert(size > 0);
00082  ugen_assert(sourceDataSize > 0);
00083  ugen_assert(sourceData != 0);
00084  
00085  data = new float[size_];
00086  
00087  if(size > sourceDataSize)
00088  {
00089   memcpy(data, sourceData, sourceDataSize * sizeof(float));
00090   memset(data + sourceDataSize, 0, (size - sourceDataSize) * sizeof(float));
00091  }
00092  else
00093  {
00094   memcpy(data, sourceData, size * sizeof(float));
00095  }
00096 
00097 #ifdef BUFFERTESTMEMORY
00098  reportDataPtr(data, size_);
00099 #endif 
00100 }

00102 BufferChannelInternal::BufferChannelInternal(const unsigned int size, const double start, const double end) throw()
00103 : size_(size),
00104  allocatedSize(size)
00105 {
00106  ugen_assert(size >= 2);
00107  
00108  data = new float[size_];
00109  //data = (float*)malloc(size_ * sizeof(float));
00110  double inc = (end - start) / (size_ - 1);
00111  double currentValue = start;
00112  float *outputSamples = data;
00113  
00114  int numSamples = size_;
00115  while(--numSamples >= 0)
00116  {
00117   *outputSamples++ = (float)currentValue;
00118   currentValue += inc;
00119  } 
00120  
00121 #ifdef BUFFERTESTMEMORY
00122  reportDataPtr(data, size_);
00123 #endif 
00124 }

00456 double Buffer::initFromJuceFile(const File& audioFile) throw()
00457 {
00458  if((audioFile == File::nonexistent) || (audioFile.exists() == false))
00459  {
00460   ugen_assertfalse;
00461   return 0.0;
00462  }
00463  
00464  AudioFormatManager formatManager;
00465  formatManager.registerBasicFormats();
00466  AudioFormatReader* audioFormatReader = formatManager.createReaderFor (audioFile);
00467  
00468  if(audioFormatReader == 0) return 0.0;
00469  
00470  double sampleRate = audioFormatReader->sampleRate;
00471  numChannels_ = audioFormatReader->numChannels;
00472  size_ = (int)audioFormatReader->lengthInSamples;
00473  channels = new BufferChannelInternal*[numChannels_];
00474  
00475  float** bufferData = new float*[numChannels_];
00476  
00477  for(int i = 0; i < numChannels_; i++)
00478  {
00479   channels[i] = new BufferChannelInternal(size_, false);
00480   bufferData[i] = channels[i]->data;
00481  }
00482  
00483  AudioSampleBuffer audioSampleBuffer(bufferData, numChannels_, size_);
00484  audioSampleBuffer.readFromAudioReader(audioFormatReader, 0, size_, 0, true, true);
00485  
00486  delete audioFormatReader;
00487  delete [] bufferData;
00488  return sampleRate;
00489 }

00513 bool Buffer::initFromJuceFile(const File& audioFile, 
00514          bool overwriteExisitingFile, 
00515          int bitDepth) throw()
00516 { 
00517  File outputFile;
00518  
00519  if(audioFile.isDirectory()) 
00520   outputFile = audioFile.getChildFile(getFileNameWithTimeIdentifier(T("Buffer")));
00521  else
00522   outputFile = audioFile;
00523   
00524  if(outputFile.getFileExtension().isEmpty())
00525   outputFile = outputFile.withFileExtension(T("wav"));
00526  
00527  if(overwriteExisitingFile == true && outputFile.exists())
00528   outputFile.deleteFile();
00529  else if(outputFile.exists())
00530   return false;
00531  
00532  AudioFormatWriter* audioFormatWriter;
00533  
00534  if(outputFile.hasFileExtension(".wav"))
00535  {
00536   WavAudioFormat wavAudioFormat;
00537   FileOutputStream* fileOutputStream = outputFile.createOutputStream();
00538   
00539   if(!fileOutputStream) return false;
00540   
00541   audioFormatWriter = wavAudioFormat.createWriterFor(fileOutputStream, 
00542                  UGen::getSampleRate(), 
00543                  getNumChannels(), 
00544                  bitDepth, 0, 0);
00545  }
00546  else if(outputFile.hasFileExtension(".aif") || outputFile.hasFileExtension(".aiff"))
00547  {
00548   AiffAudioFormat aiffAudioFormat;
00549   FileOutputStream* fileOutputStream = outputFile.createOutputStream();
00550   
00551   if(!fileOutputStream) return false;
00552   
00553   audioFormatWriter = aiffAudioFormat.createWriterFor(fileOutputStream, 
00554                UGen::getSampleRate(), 
00555                getNumChannels(), 
00556                bitDepth, 0, 0);
00557  }
00558  
00559  float **bufferData = new float*[getNumChannels()];
00560  memset(bufferData, 0, getNumChannels() * sizeof(float*));
00561  
00562  for(int i = 0; i < getNumChannels(); i++)
00563  {
00564   bufferData[i] = getData(i);
00565  }
00566  
00567  AudioSampleBuffer audioSampleBuffer(bufferData, getNumChannels(), size());
00568  audioSampleBuffer.writeToAudioWriter(audioFormatWriter, 0, size());
00569  
00570  delete audioFormatWriter;
00571  delete [] bufferData;
00572  
00573  return true;
00574 }

00595 double Buffer::initFromAudioFile(const char* audioFilePath) throw()
00596 {
00597  Text path; // this needs to be here so it doesn't get garbage collected too early
00598  
00599  if(audioFilePath[0] != '/')
00600  { 
00601   path = NSUtilities::pathInDirectory(NSUtilities::Bundle, audioFilePath);
00602   audioFilePath = path.getArray();
00603  }
00604  
00605  if (audioFilePath == 0 || audioFilePath[0] == 0) 
00606  {
00607   printf("Buffer: File path is null (perhaps it doesn't exist?\n");
00608   return 0.0;
00609  }
00610  
00611  OSStatus result;
00612  UInt32 dataSize;
00613  
00614  CFURLRef audioFileURL;
00615  audioFileURL = CFURLCreateFromFileSystemRepresentation(NULL,
00616                  (const UInt8*)audioFilePath, 
00617                  strlen(audioFilePath), 
00618                  false);
00619  
00620  AudioFileID audioFile;
00621  result = AudioFileOpenURL (audioFileURL, kAudioFileReadPermission, 0, &audioFile);
00622  CFRelease(audioFileURL);
00623  if (result != noErr) 
00624  {
00625   printf("Buffer: Could not open file: %s err=%d\n", audioFilePath, (int)result);
00626   return 0.0;
00627  }
00628  
00629  SInt64 packetCount;
00630  dataSize = sizeof(packetCount);
00631  result = AudioFileGetProperty(audioFile, kAudioFilePropertyAudioDataPacketCount, &dataSize, &packetCount);
00632  if (result != noErr) 
00633  {
00634   printf("Buffer: Could not get packet count: %s err=%d\n", audioFilePath, (int)result);
00635   AudioFileClose(audioFile);
00636   return 0.0;
00637  }
00638  
00639  AudioStreamBasicDescription format;
00640  dataSize = sizeof(format);
00641  result = AudioFileGetProperty(audioFile, kAudioFilePropertyDataFormat, &dataSize, &format);
00642  if (result != noErr) 
00643  {
00644   printf("Buffer: Could not get data format: %s err=%d\n", audioFilePath, (int)result);
00645   AudioFileClose(audioFile);
00646   return 0.0;
00647  }
00648  
00649  void* audioData = malloc(format.mBytesPerFrame * packetCount);
00650  
00651  if(audioData)
00652  {
00653   UInt32 packetsRead = packetCount;
00654   UInt32 numBytesRead = -1;
00655   result = AudioFileReadPackets(audioFile, false, &numBytesRead, NULL, 0, &packetsRead, audioData); 
00656   
00657   if (result != noErr) 
00658   {
00659    printf("Buffer: Could not read audio packets: %s err=%d\n", audioFilePath, (int)result);
00660    free(audioData);
00661    AudioFileClose(audioFile);
00662    return 0.0;
00663   }
00664   
00665   numChannels_ = format.mChannelsPerFrame;
00666   size_ = packetsRead;
00667   channels = new BufferChannelInternal*[numChannels_];
00668   
00669   for(int i = 0; i < numChannels_; i++)
00670   {
00671    channels[i] = new BufferChannelInternal(size_, false);
00672   }
00673   
00674   if(format.mFormatID != kAudioFormatLinearPCM)
00675   {
00676    printf("Buffer: Only PCM formats supported\\n");
00677    clear();
00678   }
00679   else if((format.mFormatFlags & kAudioFormatFlagIsFloat) != 0)
00680   {
00681    // float format, just need to deinterleave
00682    for(int channel = 0; channel < numChannels_; channel++)
00683    {
00684     float* bufferSamples = channels[channel]->data;
00685     float* audioFileSamples = (float*)audioData + channel;
00686     int numSamplesToProcess = size_;
00687     
00688     if((format.mFormatFlags & kAudioFormatFlagIsBigEndian) != 0)
00689     {
00690      // big endian float
00691      while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00692      {
00693       *bufferSamples = bigEndianFloat((const char*)audioFileSamples);
00694       bufferSamples++;
00695       audioFileSamples += numChannels_;
00696      }
00697     }
00698     else
00699     {
00700      while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00701      {
00702       *bufferSamples = *audioFileSamples;
00703       bufferSamples++;
00704       audioFileSamples += numChannels_;
00705      }
00706     }
00707    }
00708   }
00709   else if((format.mFormatFlags & kAudioFormatFlagIsBigEndian) != 0)
00710   {
00711    // aif and other big edian?
00712    if(format.mBitsPerChannel == 16)
00713    {
00714     const float factor = 1.0 / 0x7FFF;
00715     for(int channel = 0; channel < numChannels_; channel++)
00716     {
00717      float* bufferSamples = channels[channel]->data;
00718      SInt16* audioFileSamples = (SInt16*)audioData + channel;
00719      int numSamplesToProcess = size_;
00720      
00721      while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00722      {
00723       *bufferSamples = (float)bigEndian16Bit((const char*)audioFileSamples) * factor;
00724       bufferSamples++;
00725       audioFileSamples += numChannels_;
00726      }
00727     }
00728    }
00729    else if(format.mBitsPerChannel == 32)
00730    {
00731     const float factor = 1.0 / 0x7FFFFFFF;
00732     for(int channel = 0; channel < numChannels_; channel++)
00733     {
00734      float* bufferSamples = channels[channel]->data;
00735      SInt32* audioFileSamples = (SInt32*)audioData + channel;
00736      int numSamplesToProcess = size_;
00737      
00738      while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00739      {
00740       *bufferSamples = (float)bigEndian32Bit((const char*)audioFileSamples) * factor;
00741       bufferSamples++;
00742       audioFileSamples += numChannels_;
00743      }
00744     }
00745    }
00746    else if(format.mBitsPerChannel == 24)
00747    {
00748     const float factor = 1.0 / 0x7FFFFF;
00749     for(int channel = 0; channel < numChannels_; channel++)
00750     {
00751      float* bufferSamples = channels[channel]->data;
00752      char* audioFileSamples = (char*)audioData + (channel * 3);
00753      int numSamplesToProcess = size_;
00754      
00755      const int intInc = numChannels_ * 3;
00756      
00757      while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00758      {
00759       *bufferSamples = (float)bigEndian24Bit(audioFileSamples) * factor;
00760       bufferSamples++;
00761       audioFileSamples += intInc;
00762      }
00763     }
00764    }
00765    else
00766    {
00767     printf("Buffer: Sound file format not yet supported.");
00768     clear();
00769    }
00770   }
00771   else
00772   {
00773    // wav and other little edian?
00774    if(format.mBitsPerChannel == 16)
00775    {
00776     const float factor = 1.0 / 0x7FFF;
00777     for(int channel = 0; channel < numChannels_; channel++)
00778     {
00779      float* bufferSamples = channels[channel]->data;
00780      SInt16* audioFileSamples = (SInt16*)audioData + channel;
00781      int numSamplesToProcess = size_;
00782      
00783      while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00784      {
00785       *bufferSamples = (float)(*audioFileSamples) * factor;
00786       bufferSamples++;
00787       audioFileSamples += numChannels_;
00788      }
00789     }
00790    }
00791    else if(format.mBitsPerChannel == 32)
00792    {
00793     const float factor = 1.0 / 0x7FFFFFFF;
00794     for(int channel = 0; channel < numChannels_; channel++)
00795     {
00796      float* bufferSamples = channels[channel]->data;
00797      SInt32* audioFileSamples = (SInt32*)audioData + channel;
00798      int numSamplesToProcess = size_;
00799      
00800      while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00801      {
00802       *bufferSamples = (float)(*audioFileSamples) * factor;
00803       bufferSamples++;
00804       audioFileSamples += numChannels_;
00805      }
00806     }
00807    }
00808    else if(format.mBitsPerChannel == 24)
00809    {
00810     const float factor = 1.0 / 0x7FFFFF;
00811     for(int channel = 0; channel < numChannels_; channel++)
00812     {
00813      float* bufferSamples = channels[channel]->data;
00814      char* audioFileSamples = (char*)audioData + (channel * 3);
00815      int numSamplesToProcess = size_;
00816      
00817      const int intInc = numChannels_ * 3;
00818      
00819      while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00820      {
00821       *bufferSamples = (float)littleEndian24Bit(audioFileSamples) * factor;
00822       bufferSamples++;
00823       audioFileSamples += intInc;
00824      }
00825     }
00826    }
00827    else
00828    {
00829     printf("Buffer: Sound file format not yet supported.");
00830     clear();
00831    }
00832   }
00833  }
00834  else
00835  {
00836   printf("Buffer: Could not allocate memory for audio : %s err=%d\n", audioFilePath, (int)result);
00837  }
00838  
00839  free(audioData);
00840  AudioFileClose(audioFile);
00841  
00842  return format.mSampleRate;
00843 }
00844 
00845 bool Buffer::write(Text const& audioFilePath, 
00846        bool overwriteExisitingFile, 
00847        int bitDepth) throw()
00848 {
00849  ugen_assert(bitDepth >= 16);
00850  
00851  enum AudioFileType { WAV, AIFF };
00852  AudioFileType type;
00853  
00854  TextArray split = audioFilePath.split(".");
00855  int splitLength = split.length();
00856  
00857  Text pathChecked; 
00858  if(splitLength <= 1)
00859  {
00860   pathChecked = audioFilePath << ".wav";
00861   type = WAV;
00862  }
00863  else
00864  {
00865   pathChecked = audioFilePath;
00866   if(split.last().equalsIgnoreCase("aif") || 
00867      split.last().equalsIgnoreCase("aiff"))
00868   {
00869    type = AIFF;
00870   }
00871   else
00872   {
00873    type = WAV;
00874   }
00875  }
00876   
00877  if(type == AIFF)
00878  {
00879   if(bitDepth == 24)
00880    return initFromAudioFileAiff24(pathChecked.getArray(), overwriteExisitingFile);
00881   else if(bitDepth == 32)
00882    return initFromAudioFileAiff32(pathChecked.getArray(), overwriteExisitingFile);
00883   else
00884   {
00885    if(bitDepth != 16)
00886     printf("Buffer: warning: bit depth of %d not supported, using 16\n", bitDepth);
00887    return initFromAudioFileAiff16(pathChecked.getArray(), overwriteExisitingFile);
00888   }
00889  }
00890  else if(type == WAV)
00891  {
00892   if(bitDepth == 24)
00893    return initFromAudioFileWav24(pathChecked.getArray(), overwriteExisitingFile);
00894   else if(bitDepth == 32)
00895    return initFromAudioFileWav32(pathChecked.getArray(), overwriteExisitingFile);
00896   else
00897   {
00898    if(bitDepth != 16)
00899     printf("Buffer: warning: bit depth of %d not supported, using 16\n", bitDepth);
00900    return initFromAudioFileWav16(pathChecked.getArray(), overwriteExisitingFile);
00901   }
00902  }
00903  
00904  return false;
00905 }
00906 
00907 bool Buffer::initFromAudioFileWav16(const char* audioFilePath, 
00908          bool overwriteExisitingFile) throw()
00909 { 
00910  ugen_assert(audioFilePath != 0);
00911  
00912  Text path; // this needs to be here so it doesn't get garbage collected too early
00913  
00914  if(audioFilePath[0] != '/')
00915  { 
00916   path = NSUtilities::pathInDirectory(NSUtilities::Documents, audioFilePath);
00917   audioFilePath = path.getArray();
00918  }
00919  
00920  CFURLRef fileURL = CFURLCreateFromFileSystemRepresentation(NULL, 
00921                   (UInt8*)audioFilePath, 
00922                   strlen(audioFilePath), 
00923                   false);
00924  
00925  AudioStreamBasicDescription format;
00926  
00927  const int numChannels = getNumChannels();
00928  
00929  format.mChannelsPerFrame = numChannels;
00930  format.mSampleRate   = UGen::getSampleRate();
00931  format.mFormatID   = kAudioFormatLinearPCM;
00932  format.mFormatFlags   = kAudioFormatFlagIsSignedInteger | kAudioFormatFlagIsPacked;
00933  format.mBitsPerChannel  = 16;
00934  format.mBytesPerFrame  = format.mChannelsPerFrame * format.mBitsPerChannel / 8;
00935  format.mFramesPerPacket  = 1;
00936  format.mBytesPerPacket  = format.mBytesPerFrame * format.mFramesPerPacket;
00937  
00938  AudioFileID audioFile;
00939  OSStatus status = AudioFileCreateWithURL(fileURL,
00940             kAudioFileWAVEType,
00941             &format,
00942             overwriteExisitingFile ? kAudioFileFlags_EraseFile : 0,
00943             &audioFile);
00944  
00945  if(status) return false;
00946  
00947  UInt32 sizeInBytes = format.mBytesPerFrame;
00948  SInt16 intValues[numChannels];
00949  
00950  const float factor = 0x7FFF;
00951  
00952  const int numSamples = size();
00953  for(int sample = 0; sample < numSamples; sample++)
00954  {
00955   for(int channel = 0; channel < numChannels; channel++)
00956   {
00957    intValues[channel] = (SInt16)(getSampleUnchecked(channel, sample) * factor);
00958   }
00959     
00960   UInt32 ioNumPackets = 1;
00961   status = AudioFileWritePackets(audioFile,
00962             false,
00963             sizeInBytes,
00964             NULL,
00965             sample,
00966             &ioNumPackets,
00967             intValues);
00968   
00969   if(ioNumPackets == 0)
00970   {
00971    printf("Buffer: error: writing file\n");
00972    AudioFileClose(audioFile);
00973    return false;
00974   }
00975  }
00976  
00977  AudioFileClose(audioFile);
00978  return true;
00979 }

01317             kAudioFileAIFFType,
01318             &format,
01319             overwriteExisitingFile ? kAudioFileFlags_EraseFile : 0,
01320             &audioFile);
01321  
01322  if(status) return false;
01323  
01324  UInt32 sizeInBytes = format.mBytesPerFrame;
01325  SInt32 intValues[numChannels];
01326  
01327  const float factor = 0x7FFFFFFF;
01328  
01329  const int numSamples = size();
01330  for(int sample = 0; sample < numSamples; sample++)
01331  {
01332   for(int channel = 0; channel < numChannels; channel++)
01333   {
01334    intValues[channel] = (SInt32)(getSampleUnchecked(channel, sample) * factor);
01335    intValues[channel] = bigEndian32Bit((const char*)&intValues[channel]);
01336   }
01337   
01338   UInt32 ioNumPackets = 1;
01339   status = AudioFileWritePackets(audioFile,
01340             false,
01341             sizeInBytes,
01342             NULL,
01343             sample,
01344             &ioNumPackets,
01345             intValues);
01346   
01347   if(ioNumPackets == 0)
01348   {
01349    printf("Buffer: error: writing file\n");
01350    AudioFileClose(audioFile);
01351    return false;
01352   }
01353  }
01354  
01355  AudioFileClose(audioFile);
01356  return true;
01357 }

01359 #endif

01391 Buffer Buffer::interleave() throw()
01392 {
01393  if(size_ < 1 || numChannels_ < 1) return Buffer();
01394  
01395  Buffer intervleavedBuffer = BufferSpec(size_ * numChannels_, 1, false);
01396  
01397  for(int channel = 0; channel < numChannels_; channel++)
01398  {
01399   int numSamplesToProcess = size_;
01400   const float * srcSamples = getData(channel);
01401   float* dstSamples = intervleavedBuffer.getData() + channel;
01402   
01403   while(numSamplesToProcess--)
01404   {
01405    *dstSamples = *srcSamples++;
01406    dstSamples += numChannels_;
01407   }
01408  }
01409  
01410  return intervleavedBuffer;
01411 }
01412 
01413 Buffer Buffer::deinterleave(const int numInterleavedChannels) throw()
01414 {
01415  ugen_assert(numChannels_ == 1);
01416  ugen_assert((size_ % numInterleavedChannels) == 0);
01417  
01418  const int newSize = size_ / numInterleavedChannels;
01419  Buffer deintervleavedBuffer = BufferSpec(newSize, 
01420             numInterleavedChannels, 
01421             false);
01422  
01423  for(int channel = 0; channel < numInterleavedChannels; channel++)
01424  {
01425   int numSamplesToProcess = newSize;
01426   const float * srcSamples = getData() + channel;
01427   float* dstSamples = deintervleavedBuffer.getData(channel);
01428   
01429   while(numSamplesToProcess--)
01430   {
01431    *dstSamples++ = *srcSamples;
01432    srcSamples += numInterleavedChannels;
01433   }
01434  }
01435  
01436  return deintervleavedBuffer; 
01437 }

01655 
01656 Buffer Buffer::getRegion(const int startSample, 
01657        const int endSample, 
01658        const int startChannel, 
01659        const int endChannel) const throw()
01660 {
01661  int newSize, newNumChannels;
01662  int sampleStep = 1, channelStep = 1;
01663  int currentChannel;
01664  
01665  if(endSample == -1)
01666   newSize = size_ - startSample;
01667  else if(endSample > startSample)
01668   newSize = endSample - startSample + 1;
01669  else
01670  {
01671   newSize = startSample - endSample + 1;
01672   sampleStep = -1;
01673  }
01674  
01675  if(startChannel == -1)
01676  {
01677   currentChannel = 0;
01678   newNumChannels = numChannels_;
01679  }
01680  else
01681  {
01682   currentChannel = startChannel;
01683   
01684   if(endChannel == -1)
01685    newNumChannels = numChannels_ - startChannel;
01686   else if(endChannel > startChannel)
01687    newNumChannels = endChannel - startChannel + 1;
01688   else
01689   {
01690    newNumChannels = startChannel - endChannel + 1;
01691    channelStep = -1;
01692   }
01693  }
01694  
01695  Buffer newBuffer(BufferSpec(newSize, newNumChannels, false));
01696  
01697  for(int newChannelIndex = 0; newChannelIndex < newNumChannels; newChannelIndex++, currentChannel += channelStep)
01698  {
01699   const float *inputSamples = getData(currentChannel) + startSample;
01700   
01701   float *outputSamples = newBuffer.getData(newChannelIndex);
01702   int numSamples = newSize;
01703   
01704   while(numSamples--)
01705   {
01706    *outputSamples++ = *inputSamples;
01707    inputSamples += sampleStep;
01708   }
01709  }
01710  
01711  return newBuffer;
01712 }

01729 float Buffer::sum(const int channel) const throw()
01730 {
01731  if(numChannels_ == 0 || channel < 0 || channel >= numChannels_) 
01732  {
01733   ugen_assertfalse;
01734   return 0.f;
01735  }
01736  
01737  int numSamples = size_;
01738  float* inputSamples = channels[channel]->data;
01739  float total = 0.f;
01740  
01741  while(--numSamples >= 0) {
01742   total += *inputSamples++;
01743  }
01744  
01745  return total;
01746 }

01748 float Buffer::sum() const throw()
01749 {
01750  if(numChannels_ == 0) 
01751  {
01752   ugen_assertfalse;
01753   return 0.f;
01754  }
01755  
01756  float total = 0.f;
01757  
01758  for(int channel = 0; channel < numChannels_; channel++)
01759  {
01760   total += sum(channel);
01761  }
01762  
01763  return total;
01764 }

01766 Buffer Buffer::normalise() const throw()

01771   return *this * (1.f / peak);
01772  else
01773   return *this;

01776 Buffer Buffer::normaliseEach() const throw()

01783   {

01791 float Buffer::findMaximum(const int channel) const throw()
01792 {
01793  if(numChannels_ == 0 || size_ == 0) 
01794  {
01795   ugen_assertfalse;
01796   return 0.f;
01797  }
01798  
01799  float value;
01800  
01801  if(channel >= 0)
01802  {
01803   value = getSampleUnchecked(channel, 0);
01804   for(int i = 0; i < size_; i++)
01805   {
01806    float newValue = getSampleUnchecked(channel, i);
01807    value = newValue > value ? newValue : value;
01808   }
01809  }
01810  else
01811  {
01812   value = getSampleUnchecked(0, 0);
01813   for(int i = 0; i < numChannels_; i++)
01814   {
01815    float newValue = findMaximum(i);
01816    value = newValue > value ? newValue : value;
01817   }
01818  }
01819  
01820  return value;
01821 }

01823 float Buffer::findMinimum(const int channel) const throw()

01839    value = newValue < value ? newValue : value;
01840   }
01841  }

01855 float Buffer::findPeak(const int channel) const throw()

01886 
01887 Buffer Buffer::blend(Buffer const& other, double dfraction) const throw()
01888 {
01889  if(size_ == 0 || numChannels_ == 0) return other;
01890   
01891  ugen_assert(dfraction >= -1.0 && dfraction <= 1.0);
01892  
01893  const int newNumChannels = ugen::max(numChannels_, other.numChannels_);
01894  const int maxSize = ugen::max(size_, other.size_);
01895  const int minSize = ugen::min(size_, other.size_);
01896 
01897  Buffer newBuffer(BufferSpec(maxSize, newNumChannels, false));
01898  
01899  if(dfraction >= 0.0)
01900  {  
01901   float fraction = ugen::clip((float)dfraction, 0.f, 1.f);
01902   
01903   for(int channel = 0; channel < newNumChannels; channel++)
01904   {
01905    const int thisChannel = channel % getNumChannels();
01906    const int otherChannel = channel % other.getNumChannels();
01907    
01908    for(int sample = 0; sample < minSize; sample++)
01909    {
01910     float thisValue = getSampleUnchecked(thisChannel, sample);
01911     float otherValue = other.getSampleUnchecked(otherChannel, sample);
01912     float newValue = thisValue * (1.f-fraction) + otherValue * fraction;
01913     newBuffer.setSampleUnchecked(channel, sample, newValue);
01914    }
01915    
01916    if(size_ < other.size_)
01917    {
01918     for(int sample = minSize; sample < maxSize; sample++)
01919     {
01920      float otherValue = other.getSampleUnchecked(otherChannel, sample);
01921      float newValue = otherValue * fraction;
01922      newBuffer.setSampleUnchecked(channel, sample, newValue);
01923     }
01924    }
01925    else
01926    {
01927     for(int sample = minSize; sample < maxSize; sample++)
01928     {
01929      float thisValue = getSampleUnchecked(thisChannel, sample);
01930      float newValue = thisValue * (1.f-fraction);
01931      newBuffer.setSampleUnchecked(channel, sample, newValue);
01932     }   
01933    }
01934   }
01935  }
01936  else
01937  {
01938   float fraction = ugen::neg(ugen::clip((float)dfraction, -1.f, 0.f));
01939   
01940   for(int channel = 0; channel < newNumChannels; channel++)
01941   {
01942    const int thisChannel = channel % getNumChannels();
01943    const int otherChannel = channel % other.getNumChannels();
01944    
01945    for(int sample = 0; sample < minSize; sample++)
01946    {
01947     float thisValue = getSampleUnchecked(thisChannel, sample);
01948     float otherValue = other.getSampleUnchecked(otherChannel, sample);
01949     float newValue = otherValue > thisValue ?  // peak hold
01950      otherValue : thisValue * (1.f-fraction) + otherValue * fraction;
01951     newBuffer.setSampleUnchecked(channel, sample, newValue);
01952    }
01953    
01954    if(size_ < other.size_)
01955    {
01956     for(int sample = minSize; sample < maxSize; sample++)
01957     {
01958      float otherValue = other.getSampleUnchecked(otherChannel, sample);
01959      float newValue = otherValue;
01960      newBuffer.setSampleUnchecked(channel, sample, newValue);
01961     }
01962    }
01963    else
01964    {
01965     for(int sample = minSize; sample < maxSize; sample++)
01966     {
01967      float thisValue = getSampleUnchecked(thisChannel, sample);
01968      float newValue = thisValue * (1.f-fraction);
01969      newBuffer.setSampleUnchecked(channel, sample, newValue);
01970     }   
01971    }
01972   }  
01973  }
01974  
01975  return newBuffer;
01976 }

02059 
02060 Buffer Buffer::loopFade(const float fadeTime, 
02061       EnvCurve const& fadeInShape, 
02062       EnvCurve const& fadeOutShape) const throw()
02063 {
02064  ugen_assert(fadeTime >= 0.f);
02065  
02066  const int fadeSize = fadeTime * UGen::getSampleRate();
02067  
02068  if(fadeSize >= size_ || fadeSize == 0) return *this;
02069  
02070  const int newSize = size_ - fadeSize;
02071  
02072  Buffer newBuffer(BufferSpec(newSize, numChannels_, false));
02073  for(int channel = 0; channel < numChannels_; channel++)
02074  {
02075   float *outputSamples = newBuffer.getData(channel);
02076   //memcpy(outputSamples, getDataReadOnly(channel), newSize * sizeof(float));
02077   memcpy(outputSamples, getData(channel), newSize * sizeof(float));
02078   
02079   //const float* inputSamples = getDataReadOnly(channel) + newSize;
02080   const float* inputSamples = getData(channel) + newSize;
02081   
02082   int numSamplesToProcess = fadeSize;
02083   float fadeInLevel = 0.f;
02084   float fadeOutLevel = 1.f;
02085   float fadeSlope = 1.f / fadeSize;
02086   
02087   while(numSamplesToProcess--)
02088   {
02089    float fadeIn = *outputSamples;
02090    float fadeOut = *inputSamples;
02091    
02092    *outputSamples = fadeIn * fadeInLevel + fadeOut * fadeOutLevel;   
02093       
02094    fadeInLevel += fadeSlope;
02095    fadeOutLevel -= fadeSlope;
02096    inputSamples++;
02097    outputSamples++;
02098   }
02099  }
02100  
02101  return newBuffer;
02102 }
02103 
02104 Buffer Buffer::resample(const int newSize) const throw()
02105 {
02106  ugen_assert(newSize > 0);
02107  
02108  if(size_ == 0 || size_ == newSize)
02109  {
02110   return *this;
02111  }
02112  else
02113  {
02114   Buffer newBuffer(BufferSpec(newSize, numChannels_, false));
02115   
02116   double reciprocalNewSize = 1.0 / (double)(newSize-1);
02117   
02118   for(int channel = 0; channel < numChannels_; channel++)
02119   {
02120    for(int sample = 0; sample < newSize; sample++)
02121    {
02122     float value = lookup(channel, (double)sample * reciprocalNewSize);
02123     newBuffer.setSampleUnchecked(channel, sample, value);
02124    }
02125   }
02126   
02127   return newBuffer;
02128  }
02129 }
02130 
02131 Buffer Buffer::changeSampleRate(const double oldSampleRate, const double newSampleRateIn) const throw()
02132 {
02133  const double newSampleRate = newSampleRateIn == 0.0 ? UGen::getSampleRate() : newSampleRateIn;
02134  
02135  if(oldSampleRate == newSampleRate)
02136  {
02137   return *this;
02138  }
02139  else
02140  {
02141   return resample(size_ * (newSampleRate / oldSampleRate));
02142  }
02143 }

02155   {

02159  
02160  return newBuffer;

02219 Buffer Buffer::triangleWindow(const int size) throw()
02220 {
02221  const int rampUpSize = size/2;
02222  const int rampDownSize = size-rampUpSize;
02223  Buffer rampUp = Buffer::line(rampUpSize+2, 0.0, 1.0).shrinkSize(1).getRegion(1);
02224  Buffer rampDown = Buffer::line(rampDownSize+1, 1.0, 0.0).shrinkSize(1);
02225  return (rampUp, rampDown);
02226 }

02247 Buffer Buffer::blackmanWindow(const int size, const float alpha) throw()
02248 {

02250  float a1 = 0.5f;
02251  float a2 = alpha * 0.5f;
02252  
02253  return -cosineTable(size) * a1 + cosineTable(size, 2.f) * a2 + a0;

02310 Buffer Buffer::reciprocalExceptZero() const throw()
02311 {
02312  Buffer newBuffer(BufferSpec(size_, numChannels_, false));
02313  
02314  for(int channelIndex = 0; channelIndex < numChannels_; channelIndex++)
02315  {
02316   int numSamples = size_;
02317   float* inputSamples = channels[channelIndex]->data;
02318   float* outputSamples = newBuffer.channels[channelIndex]->data;
02319   
02320   while(--numSamples >= 0) {
02321    float value = *inputSamples++;
02322    if(value == 0.f || value == -0.f)
02323     *outputSamples++ = 0.f;
02324    else
02325     *outputSamples++ = 1.f / value;
02326   }
02327  }
02328  
02329  return newBuffer;
02330 }

02332 Buffer Buffer::reverse() const throw()
02333 {
02334  Buffer newBuffer(BufferSpec(size_, numChannels_, false));
02335  
02336  for(int channelIndex = 0; channelIndex < numChannels_; channelIndex++)
02337  {
02338   int numSamples = size_;
02339   float* inputSamples = channels[channelIndex]->data + numSamples - 1;
02340   float* outputSamples = newBuffer.channels[channelIndex]->data;
02341   
02342   while(--numSamples >= 0) {
02343    *outputSamples++ = *inputSamples--;
02344   }
02345  }
02346  
02347  return newBuffer;
02348 }

02350 Buffer Buffer::mix() const throw()
02351 {
02352  Buffer newBuffer(BufferSpec(size_, 1, true));
02353  
02354  int channelIndex = 0;
02355  
02356  do
02357  {
02358   int numSamples = size_;
02359   float* inputSamples = channels[channelIndex]->data;
02360   float* outputSamples = newBuffer.channels[0]->data;
02361   
02362   while(--numSamples >= 0) {
02363    *outputSamples++ += *inputSamples++;
02364   }
02365   
02366   channelIndex++;
02367  }
02368  while(channelIndex < numChannels_);
02369  
02370  return newBuffer;
02371 }

02474 ComplexBuffer ComplexBuffer::operator+ (ComplexBuffer const& rightOperand) const throw()
02475 {
02476  ComplexBuffer newBuffer(size_);
02477  
02478  const float *leftRealSamples = getDataRealReadOnly();
02479  const float *leftImagSamples = getDataImagReadOnly();
02480  const float *rightRealSamples = rightOperand.getDataRealReadOnly();
02481  const float *rightImagSamples = rightOperand.getDataImagReadOnly();
02482  float *newRealSamples = newBuffer.getDataReal();
02483  float *newImagSamples = newBuffer.getDataImag();
02484  
02485  int numSamples = size_;
02486  
02487  while(numSamples--)
02488  {
02489   *newRealSamples++ = *leftRealSamples++ + *rightRealSamples++;
02490   *newImagSamples++ = *leftImagSamples++ + *rightImagSamples++;
02491  }
02492

02494 }

02535   leftRealSamples++;
